title: Modern Access Control Is More Than Locking a Door — Here Is What It Actually Does
description: Most people think of access control as a keypad and a door strike. The reality is considerably more capable. A well-designed access control system manages credential types, enforces zone-based permissions, maintains a full audit trail, and integrates with your CCTV and alarm systems so everything responds together. With new capabilities now available across Gallagher and Inner Range platforms — including self-service access scheduling for smaller sites — there has never been a better time to review what your system can actually do for your organisation.
